question: Should aborted plugin approval cleanup be represented as `plugin.approval.resolved` with `decision: null`, or should OpenClaw use a separate cancellation/removal contract?
rationale: The PR changes a gateway/plugin SDK contract that bundled and third-party channel/plugin consumers may depend on, so automation should not decide the permanent public event shape.

options.title: Use nullable resolved cleanup
options.body: Accept `decision: null` as the cancellation signal, then update all abort-aware waiters, docs, SDK consumers, and compatibility tests around that contract.

options.title: Add a separate cancel event
options.body: Keep resolved decisions non-null and model requester cancellation through a distinct cancel or removed event, trading more protocol surface for a stricter resolved contract.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers choose the contract and the contributor can rebase the implementation against current main.

recommendation.title: Use nullable resolved cleanup
recommendation.body: Accept `decision: null` as the cancellation signal, then update all abort-aware waiters, docs, SDK consumers, and compatibility tests around that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest recent routing signal for the central gateway/plugin approval files touched by the PR.
